notes: All six pages are Purdue Krannert 'Distinguished PhD Alum' profile pages (one person each), captured by Common Crawl in 2013-05/06, 2013-12 and 2014-11. Each snapshot folder holds three .txt captures (plus .html), one more than chunk-39.json lists; all three were read and recorded, with the unlisted one flagged in its note. Degree is recorded as 'PhD' only from the page heading 'Distinguished PhD Alum'; no year, program/department or dissertation is stated, so listedYear is null and yearMeaning 'unstated'. destination/position are the current affiliation shown on the profile at capture time (e.g. University of Chicago, UCLA Anderson, USC Marshall, MSU, INSEAD, University of Illinois), not first placements. Each page's navigation also carries an Alumni > 'Graduate profiles' list of names under 2012/2013 (and an empty 2014 heading in the 2014 captures); these are site-wide alumni career profiles from the alumni/careers section, not identified as doctoral graduates, so they were not recorded. Integrator: the Hugo Sonnenschein page spells the name 'Sonnenchein'; the lookup URLs in footers alternate between krannert.purdue.edu and www.krannert.purdue.edu hosts and between 'PhD'/'phd' path case.
